career_ladder.note: Manipur Civil Service (MCS) and Manipur Police Service (MPS) are the premier state civil services under the Government of Manipur, governed by the Manipur Civil Services Rules and Manipur Police Service Rules. Officers recruit at Grade-II (Junior Grade) and advance through Senior Grade, Selection Grade, and Supertime Scale, culminating in induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) or Indian Police Service (IPS) under the All India Services Promotion Regulations.

exam_scheme.note: Examination conducted pursuant to the Manipur Civil Services Combined Competitive Examination Rules, 2022 (notified by the Department of Personnel & Administrative Reforms, Government of Manipur vide Notification dated 14 November 2022, published in Manipur Gazette Extraordinary No. 392). The scheme comprises two successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening carrying 400 marks with 1/3 negative marking and 33% qualifying threshold in CSAT Paper II) and Main Examination (Conventional descriptive written test of 6 papers totaling 1,250 merit marks + 300 marks qualifying English at 40% threshold, followed by a 150-mark Interview/Personality Test, for a grand total of 1,400 merit marks). Optional subjects were eliminated under the 2022 Rules.

stages.source_label: MPSC CCE 2022 Plan of Examination & Advt. No. 01/2022

papers.paper_name: Paper I: General Studies (National & International Events, Indian History, Geography, Polity, Governance, Economy, Environment & General Science)
papers.negative_marking: One-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to each question deducted as penalty for incorrect response
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit score in Paper I determines qualification for admission to Main Examination shortlist (approx. 12 to 13 times the number of vacancies; subject to qualifying in Paper II)

papers.paper_name: Paper II: General Studies (CSAT — Comprehension, Interpersonal Skills, Logical Reasoning, Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Basic Numeracy Class X)
papers.negative_marking: One-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to each question deducted as penalty for incorrect response
papers.qualifying_threshold: 33% (minimum 66 marks out of 200 required to qualify)

stages.stage_name: Main Examination (Conventional Written Descriptive & Interview/Personality Test)
stages.source_label: MPSC CCE 2022 Plan of Examination & Syllabi of MCSCCE 2022

papers.paper_name: Paper A: English (Comprehension, Précis Writing, Usage & Vocabulary, Short Essays — Matriculation Standard)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% (minimum 120 marks out of 300 required; marks not counted for merit ranking)

papers.paper_name: Paper I: Essay (Multiple topics evaluating concise expression, orderly ideas, and subject depth)
Paper II: General Studies I (Indian Heritage and Culture, History and Geography of the World and Society)
Paper III: General Studies II (Governance, Constitution, Polity, Social Justice and International Relations)
Paper IV: General Studies III (Technology, Economic Development, Bio-diversity, Environment, Security and Disaster Management)
Paper V: General Studies IV (Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude — Case Studies & Foundational Values of Civil Service)
Interview / Personality Test (Board Interview assessing mental alertness, social cohesion, critical assimilation, and administrative leadership)
papers.qualifying_threshold: No minimum qualifying marks; candidates summoned at approx. 2 times the number of vacancies

financial_package.note: Recruited cadres under MPSC CCE are governed by the Manipur Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019 (Manipur ROP 2019). Executive administrative cadres such as Manipur Civil Service Grade-II and Manipur Police Service Grade-II are placed in Pay Matrix Level 12 (Scale ₹53,100 - ₹1,67,800; corresponding to pre-revised PB-2 ₹9,300 - ₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹5,400 under ROP 2010), establishing an entry basic pay of ₹53,100. Allied cadres including Manipur Finance Service Grade-III, Sub-Deputy Collector (SDC), and Manipur Secretariat Service Category-VI are placed in Pay Matrix Level 10 (Scale ₹43,300 - ₹1,37,100 with entry basic pay ₹43,300).
financial_package.pay_level: Level 12 (Scale ₹53,100 - ₹1,67,800 under Manipur Services ROP Rules 2019 / PB-2 ₹9,300 - ₹34,800 + GP ₹5,400)
financial_package.pay_source_label: Manipur Public Service Commission Advt. No. 01/2022 (Clause 1: Scale of Pay for Recruited Services) & Manipur Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated based on Manipur Level 12 entry basic pay of ₹53,100 at project standard 58% Dearness Allowance (effective 1 Jul 2025) plus House Rent Allowance (10% in Imphal urban capital area, 8% or 7% in district and hill sub-divisions), medical allowance (₹500 - ₹1,000/month), and special hill compensatory allowances where admissible in hill districts; net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic + DA), Professional Tax (₹200/month), and State Group Insurance Scheme (GIS).
official_perks: Designated government residential accommodation / official quarters as per district entitlement
Official government vehicle with driver for SDO, Assistant Commissioner, and DSP executive field duties
Armed personal security / police escort for SDM and DSP executive postings in sensitive subdivisions
Medical reimbursement facilities under the Manipur Medical Attendance Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment benefits as per Manipur State Service Rules
Special Compensatory / Hill Area Allowance when posted in designated hill district headquarters
